profile.name: Anfaz Edakkavil Aboobakar
profile.tagline: I build enterprise software and intelligent systems using Java, Python, SQL, and modern AI technologies.
profile.bio: Software Engineer with nearly four years of experience developing and supporting enterprise insurance solutions using XQuery, Java, SQL, XML, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB. Experienced in document-generation systems, query optimisation, production deployments, Agile delivery, and cross-functional collaboration. MSc graduate in Artificial Intelligence with hands-on experience in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, big data processing, transformer models, multimodal AI, and explainable AI. Based in Cork, Ireland, and open to relocation.

experience.summary: Developed and supported enterprise insurance document-generation solutions for the Aetna platform on Majesco Cloud Insurer, earning three promotions during the tenure.
highlights: Developed and maintained document-generation components for the Aetna insurance platform on Majesco Cloud Insurer, primarily using XQuery with supporting Java and SQL development.
Designed, enhanced, and supported more than 30 insurance document templates, XML transformations, layouts, and data mappings within the Document-as-a-Service application.
Optimised XQuery logic and database queries across Microsoft SQL Server and MongoDB, improving query execution and reducing insurance document-generation time.
Supported monthly production releases using SVN checkout and Majesco DaaS deployment processes, including release validation, troubleshooting, and post-deployment support.
Delivered enhancements across agent onboarding, group setup and enrolment, claims upgrade merges, and insurance billing scenarios while supporting regulatory and product changes.

Collaborated with business analysts, QA engineers, frontend developers, and integration teams in a 20-member Agile team while serving as one of two dedicated DaaS engineers and mentoring junior team members.

projects.title: Multimodal Depression and Positive Affect Detection
projects.subtitle: Explainable multimodal AI for depression detection
projects.description: An end-to-end multimodal AI system combining XLM-RoBERTa text embeddings, audio-visual features, and MentalRoBERTa positive-affect representations. The system integrates independently trained encoders through projection layers and a neural fusion classifier, achieving an AUROC of 0.9867 and an F1-score of 0.9508.

projects.description: A Django web application that collects stock-market information from online sources, presents historical trends through interactive visualisations, and integrates a machine-learning pipeline to generate stock-price predictions from historical data.
